div.l: For cursing wil sle right as soiling saueth
And also war him of a Significauit
In daunger had he at his ovne gise
Yong gerlis of that Diocise
And knew her counseil ⁊and was al her rede
A garlond had he sette vpon his hede
As gret as it were for an ale stake
A bokeler had he made of a Cake
¶ With him ther rood a gentil Pardonere ·
Of Rouncivale / his frend ⁊and his compere
That streiȝt was comen fro the court of Rome
Ful loude he song come hidir loue come
The Somonour bare to him a stiffe bourdoun̄
Was neuer Trumpe of half so gret a sovne
This pardon̉er had heer̄ as yelou as wex
But smothe it hyng as doth a strike of flex
By ovncis hyng his lockis that he had
And therwith he his shuldirs oủersprad
But thynne it lay by culpons one ⁊and one
But hood for iolite werid he none
For it was trussid up on his walet
Him thought he rood al of the new Iette
Discheuelid alle save his cappe he rood bare
Such glaring eyen had he as an hare
A vernacle had he sowid upon his cappe
His walet beforn him in his lappe .
Brette fulle of pardoıı̄un come fro Rome al hote
A voice he had as smalle as hath a gote
No berd had he ne neuer shuld haue
As smothe it was as it were late y shave
I trow he were a gilding or a Mare
But of his craft from Berwik vnto ware
Ne was ther such anothir pardoner͗e
For in his male he hadde a pelow bere
Which as he seid was oure lady vayle
He seid he had a gobet of the Sayle
That seint petir had when that he went
Vpon the See til iħuIhesu him hent
He had a Cros of latoıı̄un fulle of stones ·
And in a glas he hadde piggis bones ·
